title: Person: Stephen
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Stephen

anchor.prefix:
og-in-the-blanket. And one day he had asked:

 —What is your name?

 Stephen had answered: Stephen Dedalus.

 Then Nasty Roche had said:

 —What kind of a name is that?

 And when
anchor.suffix:
had not been able to answer Nasty Roche had asked:

 —What is your father?

 Stephen had answered:

 —A gentleman.

 Then Nasty Roche had asked:

 —Is he a magistrate?

 He crept
